flag.name: MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2
flag.scope: initial web chain launch; completion re-entry requires the separate completion flag

completion_flag.name: MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2_COMPLETION
completion_flag.scope: opt-in typed completion re-entry bridge from monitor handoff

web_initial_launch.v2: web/lib/runner-v2/controller.ts -> startRunnerV2Bootstrap: agent-bootstrap-plan resolves first-agent/profile context and bootstrap-executor spawns the agent PTY directly, gates readiness, and submits instructions (typed-plan; no shell chain-runner --start — enforced by the typed-bootstrap-no-shell-start runtime proof)
web_initial_launch.fallback: shell launch when v2 is disabled or when v2 returns unsupported before typed bootstrap side effects; do not shell-fallback after v2 allocates sessions or mutates run state

completion_reentry.v2: lib/agent-functions.sh -> compiled /opt/mentiko/lib/runner-v2-complete.js when MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2_COMPLETION is enabled
completion_reentry.fallback: shell completion when completion flag is disabled or typed bridge exits unsupported (exit 64); the bridge exits unsupported for members of a live fan group because typed fan-in accounting is not wired — the shell handler owns those completions
completion_reentry.routed_coverage: agents relaunched by the typed bridge (routed chain-runner --start/--parallel) complete through the typed pipeline too: shell chain-runner monitors carry the completion flags + run-dir context inline (pty daemon whitelists spawn env), and the completion entrypoint adopts an AgentAttempt record (origin routed-completion-adoption, created at instructions_submitted from completion-time evidence) before the verdict drives the normal completed/completion_failed edges
completion_reentry.division_of_labor: exactly one handler applies completion side effects: typed bridge exit != 64 means the shell handler never runs (typed queues external effects to the outbox); exit 64 means the shell handler applies everything inline
completion_reentry.reason: completion owns fan-in, fan-out, retries, generation backstop, and event archiving; typed re-entry is opt-in until full branch parity is proven

daemon_watchers.current: chain-runner ensures mentiko-watchdog and mentiko-chain-watcher pty sessions
daemon_watchers.v2: must preserve singleton behavior before replacing shell startup

run_json.write_policy: read-modify-write under lock, temp file, atomic rename
run_json.read_policy: lock-free readers tolerate old or new whole file
run_json.initial_status: pending in shell create-run; web-created runs may already be running or pending

event_file.parser_rule: split on first colon; data may contain more colons

generation_completion_contract.core_generation_handoff: generation-result.json is authoritative; mentiko emit is optional for core generation chains
generation_completion_contract.no_emit_salvage: typed completion must import a compatible generation payload before failing a core generation agent that reached completion without its declared event
generation_completion_contract.import_effect: typed completion executor must include a generation-import effect that invokes the existing mentiko generation import path
generation_completion_contract.prompt_policy: core generation bootstrap instructions must not require mentiko emit as a mandatory final step

external_effects.outbox: typed completion adapters queue external side effects to <stateDir>/external-effects.jsonl (STATE_DIR when the engine exports it, else <runDir>/state); records carry namespaceId/orgId
external_effects.live_drain: web/server/background-worker.ts drains outboxes every 15s via drainRunnerV2ExternalEffects: claim-by-rename consumption, per-record tenant identity, bounded redelivery (3 attempts), audit to external-effects.dispatch.jsonl
external_effects.plugin_dispatch: delegates to lib/plugin-runner.sh run-plugins so plugin behavior cannot drift from the shell runner; live-drain opt-in only — probe and proof dispatch never invoke real plugins
external_effects.legacy_webhook_network: live drain delivers legacy webhooks over the network (SSRF guards live in outbound-webhook-delivery); probe dispatch requires explicit opt-in
external_effects.plain_fail_steps: plain fail decisions (agent failed, no retry policy) emit terminal-failure steps mirroring the shell no-event failure path: task-status failed, circuit-breaker record-failure, agent-failed notification, failed metadata-webhooks; the shell fires no plugins on this path so neither does typed
external_effects.agent_completion_steps: every typed completion that marks the agent complete (route, loop-complete, max-rounds-stop, terminal, generation-terminal) queues per-agent effects mirroring the top of chain-runner-complete.sh: agent-completed plugin, agent-completed notification (agent_complete type, never chain-level), and chain-config agent_complete webhooks (config.webhooks enabled + subscribed, queued as legacy-webhook records per url); unlike the shell, typed does not fire agent-completed for verdicts that fail the agent
external_effects.no_downstream_terminal: a completion whose event has no downstream work plans the full terminal completion (task-status, chain_complete webhook, chain-complete event, plugins, notifications, run-completed hooks, metadata-webhooks, legacy webhook, on_complete policy) instead of only flipping run status; a wait with downstream still in flight (targets already active or blocked on prerequisites) applies no run-terminal effects at all, matching the shell's quiet exit

monitor_contract.completion: OR-latched explicit AGENT_COMPLETE line or declared emits event match
monitor_contract.stale: stale/idle only drives advisor nudges or diagnostics
monitor_contract.env_carry: the pty daemon whitelists spawn env, so every monitor spawner must inline-export the runner-v2 completion context (MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2, MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2_COMPLETION, MENTIKO_RUN_DIR/RUNS_DIR, NAMESPACE_ID/ORG_ID, EVENTS_DIR/STATE_DIR) into the monitor command; both spawners comply — the typed bootstrap (agent-bootstrap-plan runContextExports) and the shell chain-runner mon_script — otherwise routed completions cannot reach the typed bridge
forbidden: dead without declared event implies success
monitor diagnostic event counts as handoff success

event_match.event: agent emits field lower-case equals event file event lower-case
event_match.source: event source contains agent id case-insensitive
event_match.run_id: if present in env, event run id must match

watcher_contract.condition_policy: fail closed on rejected shell metacharacters or malformed condition

watchdog_contract.alive_source: live PTY session wins over age/stale checks
watchdog_contract.foreign_scope: never reap sessions from another root/namespace/org
watchdog_contract.run_stop: use shared run lock when available
watchdog_contract.stalled_event: diagnostic run-stalled event is not canonical agent handoff

invariants: do not mutate existing shell runner behavior when MENTIKO_RUNNER_V2 is unset
do not use stale json schemas as the runtime truth
do not collapse watcher/watchdog/scheduler/completion into one implicit state machine
do not fabricate agent success events
do not archive sibling-agent or other-run events
preserve run.json lock interoperability with bash
preserve agent terminal status complete vs run status completed
preserve namespace/org/root scoping for daemon sessions
completion re-entry remains shell fallback-capable until parity tests cover every branch
known_gaps: fan-out member completions are intentionally shell-handled: the typed bridge exits unsupported (64) for members of a live fan group because typed fan-in accounting is not wired to the completion entrypoint; wiring the fan-group store into typed completion removes the last routed-coverage carve-out

task update on run completion refreshes last_run_status/timestamps but leaves last_run_agents and last_run_artifacts stale from the prior run until the run-summary pipeline rewrites them (observed live on TASK-173, 2026-07-04)
